text: ユウと　いっしょなら　しょうぶ　しても　いいけど…　２たい２で　やろうよ

structure.jp: ユウと　いっしょなら
しょうぶ　しても　いいけど…

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.explanation: てもいい after a verb says doing it is fine. しょうぶ　しても　いい = 'I don't mind battling'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending on a verb is a casual 'let's'. やろうよ = 'let's do it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells you the way something is done. ２たい２で = 'as two against two'.
